data.exact_reserve_text: During the year, the Syndicate released GBP 9.5m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (2013: GBP 7.1m).

prior_year_events.impact_description: Reserve held in the Reinsurance to Close for a significant claim on the Hamaoka nuclear plant; reserved in Yen at Yen 686m; movements reduced by sterling depreciation and matched by a loss on Yen cash held to hedge.
Reserve last year was some GBP 4m; the claim was settled at less than this at GBP 1.7m (release versus prior reserve).
An additional loss was experienced at the Urenco fuel fabrication plant in the UK, which the Syndicate paid GBP 1.5m.

prior_year_events.event_name: Possible material damage loss in China
prior_year_events.impact_description: The Syndicate established a recent reserve of GBP 1.4m as a result of a possible material damage loss in China.

named_events.loss_description: Reserved the claim in line with estimates at a cost of Yen 686m; because this is reserved in Yen which has depreciated against sterling the loss has reduced, although this reduction is matched by a loss on Yen cash held to hedge against the claim.
Claim settled at GBP 1.7m (reserve last year was some GBP 4m).
An additional loss was experienced at the Urenco fuel fabrication plant in the UK, which the Syndicate paid GBP 1.5m.

named_events.event_name: Possible material damage loss in China
named_events.loss_description: The Syndicate has established a recent reserve of GBP 1.4m as a result of a possible material damage loss in China.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate closed 2013 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 39.487m at 31 December 2013 (opening for 2014). During 2014 the Syndicate released GBP 9.5m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods, driven by favourable claims development and specific reserve settlements (for example the medical isotope claim settled below prior reserve). There is no gross claims development triangle disclosed; LOB-level prior year movements are not provided.
raw_causal_phrases: During the year, the Syndicate released GBP 9.5m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (2013: GBP 7.1m).
The 2012 underwriting year has performed well, reflecting low loss experience
The reserve last year was some GBP 4m; although the claim was settled at less than this at GBP 1.7m.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding 2013 column). Prior year movement taken from Note 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' which states a release of GBP 9.5m (treated as gross). No gross claims development triangle was found in the disclosed pages; LOB-level prior year movements are not provided so LOB-level amounts are null. Some prior-year event amounts (e.g. medical isotope settlement, Urenco payment, China reserve) are reported in the narrative and have been included in prior_year_events; conversions and aggregation were kept in native GBP as reported.
